law-of-supply.def: As the price of a good rises, the quantity sellers offer rises, other things equal; the supply curve slopes upward.

quantity-supplied.def: The amount of a good sellers offer at one particular price. A change in the good's own price changes the quantity supplied, a movement along the supply curve.

supply-shifter.def: Anything other than the good's own price that changes supply and shifts the curve: input costs, technology, taxes and subsidies on producers, expectations and the number of sellers.
